learningObjectives: Calculate and interpret common descriptive statistics.
Understand variance, standard deviation, and distribution spread.
Use statistical measures to summarize datasets.

activities.title: Explore Central Tendency
activities.instruction: Adjust the dataset and observe how mean, median, and mode respond.

content.concept: Mean, median, and mode describe the center of a dataset from different perspectives.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Anatomy of Standard Deviation
activities.instruction: Explore the components involved in measuring data spread.

content.concept: Standard deviation measures the typical spread of values around the mean.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: The collection of numerical observations being analyzed.
The arithmetic average of the observations.
The difference between an observation and the mean.
The squared difference used when calculating variance.
The average of the squared deviations.
The square root of variance, expressed in the original units.

activities.title: Match Statistics to Meaning
activities.instruction: Match each statistical measure with what it describes.

content.concept: Range, variance, standard deviation, percentiles, and quartiles describe different aspects of a data distribution.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: Range → Difference between maximum and minimum
Variance → Average squared deviation from the mean
Standard Deviation → Typical spread around the mean
Percentile → Value below which a specified percentage of observations fall
Quartile → Divides ordered data into four parts

activities.title: Build a Statistical Summary
activities.instruction: Select the measures needed to summarize the center and spread of a dataset.

content.concept: A statistical summary provides compact information about the center, spread, and distribution of numerical data.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
